rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the tomato fruit, including one used in cooking.

example.english: I bought a tomato to make soup.
example.traditional: 我買咗個番茄返嚟煮湯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 faan1 ke4 faan1 lei4 zyu2 tong1

rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean the tomato plant rather than its fruit.

example.english: We have a tomato plant growing on our balcony.
example.traditional: 我哋屋企露台種咗棵番茄樹。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 lou6 toi4 zung3 zo2 fo2 faan1 ke4 syu6
